name: Onee-chan no Seikyouiku ~Cool ni do M Choukyou Shite Ageru~
original_name: お姉ちゃんの性教育～クールにドM調教してあげる～
source:
Little brother Izumi is curious about sex things,
so he asks the highest authority on grownup things... his older sister, Kanna.
The cooldere onechan is happy to show him everything...
